issues.quote: WHEREAS, on 14 September 2026, the Owner sued the Installer in the Circuit Court for Duval County, Florida, Case No. 2026-CA-004417 (the "Lawsuit"), alleging defects in commercial kitchen equipment that the Installer installed at the Owner's restaurant at Two Riverside Place, Jacksonville, Florida; and

This Settlement Agreement and Release (this "Agreement") is dated February 2, 2027, and is between Gulfstream Hospitality Group, LLC, a Florida limited liability company (the "Owner"), and Coastal Kitchen Installations, Inc., a Georgia corporation (the "Installer").
issues.why: Document-wide: party names defined and used with "the" (the Owner, the Installer).

issues.quote: 1.1 The Installer will pay the Owner Forty-Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($42,500.00) (the "Settlement Amount") within ten (10) days of the date of this Agreement.
The Installer will pay the Owner Forty-Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($42,500.00) (the "Settlement Amount") within ten (10) days of the date of this Agreement.
issues.why: "will" used to impose a duty on a party.

issues.quote: The Installer will pay the Owner Forty-Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($42,500.00) (the "Settlement Amount") within ten (10) days of the date of this Agreement.
The Installer will pay the Owner Forty-Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($42,500.00) (the "Settlement Amount") within ten (10) days of the date of this Agreement.

issues.anchor: days of the date of this Agreement
issues.quote: The Installer will pay the Owner Forty-Two Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($42,500.00) (the "Settlement Amount") within ten (10) days of the date of this Agreement.
issues.why: "within 10 days of" can mean before or after.
issues.fix: no later than 10 days after the date of this agreement

issues.quote: The Owner releases the Installer from any and all claims arising out of or relating to the Lawsuit or the kitchen equipment, including but not limited to claims for breach of warranty, negligence, and delay damages.

issues.anchor: arising out of or relating to
issues.quote: The Owner releases the Installer from any and all claims arising out of or relating to the Lawsuit or the kitchen equipment, including but not limited to claims for breach of warranty, negligence, and delay damages.
issues.fix: arising out of the Lawsuit or the kitchen equipment

issues.quote: The Owner releases the Installer from any and all claims arising out of or relating to the Lawsuit or the kitchen equipment, including but not limited to claims for breach of warranty, negligence, and delay damages.
issues.why: "including but not limited to" where "including" suffices.

issues.quote: The Owner's release does not extend to any latent defect that the Installer knows or should have known about and did not disclose to the Owner before the date of this Agreement.
issues.why: Knowledge standard "knows or should have known": flag it, don't rewrite it.
issues.fix: Leave the wording; offer a defined Knowledge term (MSCD 13.506).

issues.quote: The Installer releases the Owner from all claims arising out of the Lawsuit, and the Installer shall not assert the same in any later proceeding.
issues.fix: and Installer shall not assert those claims in any later proceeding.

issues.anchor: The parties acknowledge and agree that
issues.quote: The parties acknowledge and agree that the Owner shall file a stipulation of dismissal with prejudice in the form of Exhibit A no later than 5 days after the Owner receives the Settlement Amount.
issues.fix: Owner shall file a stipulation of dismissal with prejudice in the form of Exhibit 1 ...

issues.quote: EXHIBIT A
issues.why: Lettered exhibit; exhibits take numbers. A form of stipulation is correctly an exhibit.

issues.quote: The terms of this Agreement shall be kept confidential, except for disclosures to a party's attorneys, accountants, and insurers.
issues.why: Passive hides who must keep the terms confidential.
issues.fix: Each party shall keep the terms of this agreement confidential, except for disclosures to its attorneys, accountants, and insurers.

issues.quote: No party shall make any statement that disparages another party regarding the Lawsuit.
issues.fix: No party may make any statement that disparages another party regarding the Lawsuit.

issues.quote: This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and assigns.
Entire agreement:  This Agreement is the parties' entire agreement regarding the Lawsuit.

notes: Other side's draft. Party-article and 1.1 numbering are document-wide. The WHEREAS issue covers both recitals. Section 1.1 holds 4 separate issues (category-will, 2 number-words, time-ambiguity). The release in 2.1 holds 3. The Exhibit A form uses the court's name in capitals; its "Defendant.  Case No." line has the correct 2 spaces.
